latest_release.body:
## General

<details>
<summary>Bug Fixes (12)</summary>

* Email, import, account-merging, and other processing actions can no longer be triggered by opening a link, and queued work starts only after the related document is saved. Cancelling a **Quotation** now clears its _Lost Reasons_. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/64151)
* When _Enable Stock Reservation_ is off in **Stock Settings**, **Work Order**, **Production Plan**, **Subcontracting Order**, and **Sales Order** ignore a previously selected _Reserve Stock_ option and do not create stock reservations on submission. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/64142)
* The setup wizard now sets _How Often Should Sales Data Be Updated in Company/Project?_ to Daily in **Selling Settings**, rather than updating sales totals with each transaction. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/64202)
* Corrects the Finnish appointment-time validation message so it displays without causing a formatting error. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/64308)
* Adds a common date-range check to reports, flagging when _From Date_ is later than _To Date_ instead of showing empty or misleading results. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/64236)
* During upgrades, **Workstation Operating Component** records leave the account blank when the company’s default is not a valid expense account for that company, allowing the migration to continue. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/64425)
* Filters invoices available for discounting by company and user access, checks account access before retrieving **Bank Clearance** entries, and reuses **Delivery Schedule Item** rows only for the matching **Sales Order** and **Sales Order Item**. Applies user permissions to warehouse stock and order lookups in **Production Plan**, and shows order details only for submitted **Sales Order** records. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/64645)
* CRM now checks edit access before linking **Contact** and **Address** records or reusing an existing **Customer**; running bank transaction rules also requires edit access to **Bank Transaction** records. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/64646)
* Filters account choices in **Supplier** and **Customer** default account entries by _Billing Currency_, showing accounts in the company’s currency when no billing currency is set. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/65039)
* Updates **Email Digest** emails to show each recipient’s personal items, use company-currency totals, and exclude draft transactions and expired quotations. Financial summaries and lists respect recipients’ access, links open the correct records, and a failed scheduled email does not stop later sends. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/65519)
* Adds whole-number quantity checks, including for stock-unit quantities, in **Purchase Order**, **Subcontracting Order**, **Subcontracting Receipt**, **Material Request**, **Supplier Quotation**, **Request for Quotation**, and **Pick List**. Rejects disabled units of measure on **Item** records and transactions, and blocks unit merges that would create duplicate conversion entries on an **Item**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/65525)
* Adds validation for a **Company**’s default accounts, cost centers, and warehouses, and blocks changes to perpetual inventory or currency when posted stock or ledger entries are affected. It also cleans up some linked records and blocks deletion when linked **BOM** or **Employee** records remain, restricts manual default tax-template creation to System Managers and Accounts Managers, keeps provisional-expense details visible when any company needs them, and excludes opening invoices from monthly sales totals. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/65514)

</details>
